mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months, indicating a rapidly tightening labor market, will lead to wage inflation and reduced corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines >0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2pp year-over-year, it signals a supply-side slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as corporations face rising input costs and reduced output.
failure_condition: INDPRO y-o-y growth declines >2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher borrowing costs reduce investment and consumption.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y growth > 10% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 1% year-over-year, it signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS y-o-y growth < -1% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures accelerate by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter, it signals a surge in consumer demand that will boost corporate revenues and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS q-o-q growth > 2% but SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3% year-over-year, and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a high-inflation, low-interest-rate environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors demand higher real returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL y-o-y > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.
